mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, increasing valuation multiples and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns is negative or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 7.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to corporate earnings contraction and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 7.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 13600) combined with rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 230) signals overheating economy, prompting Federal Reserve tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 > 13600 and CPIAUCSL > 230.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, declining housing starts (HOUST < 850) signals weakening consumer demand and impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansion when HOUST declines below 850.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 95.0) signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and earnings, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), high non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS > 134000) signal robust economic growth and positive corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances during tight labor market (UNRATE < 4.0%) when PAYEMS > 134000.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained industrial production decline (INDPRO < 95.0) over 3 months signals manufacturing slowdown, reducing corporate output and earnings, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp CPI rise (CPIAUCSL > 232.0) signals accelerating inflation, prompting Federal Reserve rate hike expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 232.0.
